group:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:rea.overview: 作者小时候总被告诫别吃胖，和食物的关系因此受损多年。女儿说自己太胖后，她借心理学教授马基的建议反思：在饮食上父母少说为好，定时提供健康食物，吃什么、吃多少交给孩子。
group:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:rea.fullTranslationZh:
小时候，总有人告诉我什么不能吃。“你可不想长胖吧”这句话在我整个童年里反复出现。它真的搞乱了我和食物的关系——我花了好多年才走出来。正因为如此，我很注意不把孩子的体重和他们作为人的价值联系在一起。我鼓励女儿选择健康的零食，也常常劝她别再吃第二份甜点。可是有一天，我听到她说“我觉得我太胖了”，心一下子沉了下去。这让我怀疑，给她零食方面的建议是不是无意中产生了负面影响。

心理学教授夏洛特·马基认为，食物是为人父母少说反而更好的少数话题之一。“育儿中有很多事情值得和孩子好好聊聊，但我不认为食物是其中之一，”她说，“谈食物只会让孩子产生一些不一定健康的担忧和不安。”

相反，她建议采用营养专家熟知的一个理念，叫作“责任分工”：父母在固定时间给孩子提供多种以健康为主的食物，由孩子自己决定想吃什么、吃多少——即便这意味着他们偶尔吃的饼干比胡萝卜多。

让孩子想吃什么就吃什么，也能让他们体会到自己选择带来的自然后果。“孩子说‘我肚子疼’的时候，你可以说：‘嗯，你吃了很多含糖的东西，要是换些别的吃，可能会舒服点。’”马基说，“让他们觉得自己对这件事有一定的掌控权。”

我一直在尝试这些方法，发现当我管得少一些时，孩子们确实会做出更好的选择。“喂养是一场持久战，”马基说，“家里有什么食物，影响很大。就算他们不吃，他们也看在眼里。然后突然有一天，他们就开窍了。”

selectedLongSentences.displayText: Instead, she recommends applying a well-known concept among nutrition experts called the “Division of Responsibility,” where parents provide a variety of mostly healthy foods to their kids at fixed times, and the kids themselves decide what and how much they want to consume – even if that means occasionally eating more cookies than carrots.

selectedLongSentences.analysisZh: 主干很短：she recommends applying a well-known concept，recommend doing 是「建议做某事」。concept 后面先用 among nutrition experts 说明它在营养专家中有名，再用过去分词 called the “Division of Responsibility” 给出名字。where 引导的定语从句解释这个「分工」，被 and 分成两半：parents provide … at fixed times 是父母负责的部分，the kids themselves decide what and how much they want to consume 是孩子负责的部分，decide 后接 what and how much 引导的宾语从句。破折号后的 even if 是让步补充：哪怕偶尔饼干吃得比胡萝卜多，也照样让孩子自己决定。

selectedLongSentences.translationZh: 心理学教授夏洛特·马基认为，食物是为人父母少说反而更好的少数话题之一。
selectedLongSentences.analysisZh: 主干是 food is one of the rare subjects（食物是少有的话题之一）。a professor of psychology 是 Charlotte Markey 的同位语，交代她的身份。where 引导定语从句修饰 subjects，从句的主语是动名词 saying less，谓语是 is more，中间插入的 as parents 表示「作为父母」。saying less is more 字面是「说得少就是多」，意思是少说反而效果更好，这句话定下了 Markey 对饮食话题的基本态度。

discourseStructure.summary: 作者先讲自己童年被管饮食的伤害和女儿说自己太胖带来的担忧，再引专家 Markey 的观点：饮食上少说、实行父母和孩子的责任分工、让孩子体会选择的后果；最后作者以亲身尝试的效果收尾。

paragraphs.summary: 作者童年常被告诫别吃胖，伤了她和食物的关系；女儿说自己太胖，让她担心自己的零食建议起了反作用。
paragraphs.function: 以个人经历引出话题和困惑。

paragraphs.summary: Markey 认为饮食问题上父母少说为好，多谈会让孩子不安。
paragraphs.function: 引出专家观点，回应作者的困惑。

paragraphs.summary: Markey 推荐“责任分工”：父母定时提供多样健康的食物，孩子自己决定吃什么、吃多少。
让孩子自主选择，也能让他们承受选择的自然后果，从而有掌控感。
paragraphs.function: 进一步说明这种做法的好处。

paragraphs.summary: 作者尝试后发现少限制反而让孩子选得更好；Markey 说喂养是持久战，家里备什么食物很重要。
paragraphs.function: 用实践效果和专家补充收尾。

question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.questionFocus: 读完首段作者的童年回忆和眼下的做法，推出她对自己当年被管饮食的看法。
question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.stemTranslationZh: 从第一段可以推断出作者的什么情况？
question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.locateFindZh: [[block:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:reading-b:1]]先说总被叮嘱别吃胖，这 messed up 她和食物的关系，于是对女儿换种做法；答案要说出她对当年喂养的态度

optionAnalysis.label: A
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 她为孩子们的体重而烦恼。

trap.relationNote: 选项的 weight 来自原文 weigh，但原句是 I’m careful not to connect what my kids weigh with their worth as people，她是刻意不把孩子的体重和价值挂钩。后来让她心里一沉的是女儿自己说太胖，她担心的是自己的零食建议起了反作用，不是孩子的体重。

trapEvidence.quote: Because of this, I’m careful not to connect what my kids weigh with their worth as people.

optionAnalysis.label: B
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 她对自己小时候被喂养的方式持批评态度。

evidence.quote: It really messed up my relationship with food – something that took me years to overcome.
“You don’t want to get fat” was on constant repeat throughout my childhood.
Because of this, I’m careful not to connect what my kids weigh with their worth as people.

trap.claim: She is interested in making food.
trap.explanation: 首段谈的是该吃什么、不该吃什么，以及孩子的零食和甜点，作者没有提到自己喜欢下厨做饭。

optionAnalysis.label: D
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 她对自己吃什么很挑剔。

trap.sourceQuote: I encourage my daughter to make healthy snack choices
trap.optionText: She is particular about what she eats.
trap.explanation: 首段里被管着吃什么的人是女儿：作者鼓励女儿选健康零食、劝女儿别吃第二份甜点。至于作者自己，原文只说小时候常被大人告诫 what not to eat，没说她现在对自己的饮食很挑剔。

trapEvidence.quote: I encourage my daughter to make healthy snack choices and often dissuade（劝阻）her from a second dessert.

locationParaphrases.sourceText: She is critical of the way she was fed.
locationParaphrases.targetText: It really messed up my relationship with food – something that took me years to overcome.
locationParaphrases.note: 原文没有直接说「我批评」，要自己跨一步：她说小时候没完没了地听 “You don’t want to get fat”，这 really messed up 了她和食物的关系，花了好多年才 overcome；接着又说 Because of this，她刻意不在孩子身上重复。把自己受的伤害说出来、还决心不让孩子再经历，说明她不认同当年被喂养的方式。

question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.questionFocus: 拿四种做法去对照 Markey 的主张，找出她会反对的那一种。

trapEvidence.quote: even if that means occasionally eating more cookies than carrots

optionAnalysis.label: B

trap.explanation: 这正是第三段 Markey 推荐的责任分工里父母负责的那一半：parents provide a variety of mostly healthy foods to their kids at fixed times。她主张这样做，不会反对。

trapEvidence.quote: parents provide a variety of mostly healthy foods to their kids at fixed times

optionAnalysis.label: C
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 向孩子讲解吃零食的风险。

evidence.quote: food is one of the rare subjects where, as parents, saying less is more

optionAnalysis.label: D
optionAnalysis.optionTranslationZh: 吃饭时和孩子聊学校的事。

trap.sourceQuote: There are so many things in parenting that are good to talk through
trap.optionText: Talking with kids about school at mealtimes.
trap.explanation: Markey 只是不主张和孩子多谈食物，她紧接着说 There are so many things in parenting that are good to talk through。饭桌上聊学校，聊的不是食物，原文并没有反对；把「少谈食物」扩大成「吃饭时少说话」就读过头了。

trapEvidence.quote: There are so many things in parenting that are good to talk through

locationParaphrases.sourceText: Explaining to kids the risks of taking snacks.
locationParaphrases.targetText: food is one of the rare subjects where, as parents, saying less is more
locationParaphrases.note: 给孩子讲零食的风险，就是在饮食这件事上多说。Markey 认为饮食是 saying less is more 的话题，还说谈这些 just creates some worries and insecurities in kids，所以这种做法正是她不赞成的。

question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.questionFocus: 在“责任分工”的定义里分清父母管什么、孩子管什么。
question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.stemTranslationZh: 根据“责任分工”原则，孩子应该做什么？

evidence.quote: the kids themselves decide what and how much they want to consume
evidence.anchor: 第三段 and 后半句

trap.claim: Share their food with other kids.
trap.explanation: 责任分工只在父母和自家孩子之间分：父母定时提供食物，孩子决定吃什么、吃多少。原文没有提到和别的孩子分享食物。

trap.sourceText: parents provide a variety of mostly healthy foods
trap.relationNote: 选项的 provided 来自原文 provide，但 provide 在原文是父母的职责：提供多种健康食物。吃多少由孩子自己定（what and how much），并不要求把提供的食物吃完。

trapEvidence.quote: parents provide a variety of mostly healthy foods to their kids at fixed times

trap.claim: Help their parents do the dishes.
trap.explanation: Division of Responsibility 听起来像分配家务，但原文讲的是吃饭上的分工：父母管提供什么、什么时候提供，孩子管吃什么、吃多少，没有提洗碗。

locationParaphrases.targetText: Instead, she recommends applying a well-known concept among nutrition experts called the “Division of Responsibility,” where parents provide a variety of mostly healthy foods to their kids at fixed times, and the kids themselves decide what and how much they want to consume – even if that means occasionally eating more cookies than carrots.
locationParaphrases.answerText: the kids themselves decide what and how much they want to consume
locationParaphrases.note: 题干 Division of Responsibility 原词出现在第三段，where 从句就是它的具体内容。

locationParaphrases.sourceText: Make diet decisions on their own.
locationParaphrases.targetText: the kids themselves decide what and how much they want to consume
locationParaphrases.note: on their own 对应 themselves，make diet decisions 对应 decide what and how much they want to consume：吃什么、吃多少由孩子自己定。

question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.questionFocus: 从作者试用这些方法后的结果，判断她对方法的评价。
question:paper-gaokao-2025-zhejiang-jan:.stemTranslationZh: 作者认为自己一直在用的这些方法怎么样？

trap.explanation: 原文没有提到这些方法要花多少钱。末段的 The food you have available makes a huge difference 说的是家里摆着什么食物很关键，不是花费大。
作者做的其实是少说、少限制（less restrictive），原文没说操作复杂。Feeding is a long game 指喂养要耐心等效果慢慢出来，不是方法难办。

evidence.quote: I’ve been trying out these strategies and I’ve found that when I’m less restrictive, they do make better decisions.

trap.explanation: 作者试过后发现 they do make better decisions，方法和效果是一致的，原文没说这些方法自相矛盾。前后不同的只是她自己：从常劝女儿少吃甜点，变成管得更少。

locationParaphrases.targetText: I’ve been trying out these strategies and I’ve found that when I’m less restrictive, they do make better decisions.
locationParaphrases.answerText: when I’m less restrictive, they do make better decisions
locationParaphrases.note: 题干 strategies 原词出现在末段首句，题干 has been following 对应 I’ve been trying out。

locationParaphrases.targetText: when I’m less restrictive, they do make better decisions
locationParaphrases.note: 作者照着做了，结果是管得少了孩子反而选得更好，do 还加强了语气：「确实」更好。方法试过见效，说明她认为这些方法行得通，即 Workable。
